physical_subject: How can the same workload have a smaller sum of completion times?
relationship: Shortest processing time first minimizes the sum of completion times on one machine when all jobs are ready, equally weighted, and have no setup or precedence constraints.
operation: Compare identified job blocks and finish marks; isolate an adjacent interchange and prove the saving.
closest_prior: Earlier Little law, optimal stopping, traveling salesman and gradient descent
substantive_difference: Single-machine adjacent-exchange proof for total completion time; not steady-state queues, route length or stopping strategy.
